items.title: Define and pin the replay experiment contract and sample corpus
items.context: Version the experiment schema; pin contract/model/token estimator, seeded and adjudicated finding sets, repetitions, sample classes, reconstruction prerequisites and INCONCLUSIVE rules so later savings claims are reproducible rather than post-hoc.

happy.desc: A versioned, canonical experiment contract pins the A/B arm definitions, exact same-input material envelope, model and controllable sampling settings, estimator and contract versions, run order, at least three repetitions per applicable cell, three required historical sample classes with at least two samples each, and a pre-adjudicated stable finding set before any result is recorded; every seeded critical/high finding pins stable ID/category/severity/trigger plus independent machine or human adjudication evidence, matching uses normalized semantic category plus source/claim binding rather than wording, all critical findings must be detected, suspected systematic high misses require rerun and independent adjudication, and natural new findings or false positives are non-self-authenticating; rerunning the same contract yields the same experiment identity and corpus digests.

edge.desc: The contract explicitly distinguishes assembled prompt, known dispatch input, and provider-processed input; provider seed/tool/usage/cache dimensions that cannot be observed are recorded as unavailable with reason and never as zero, while unsupported sampling controls and partially reconstructable samples are declared before comparison rather than normalized post-hoc.

adversarial.desc: Changing a frozen arm, sample, repetition count, model/contract/estimator version, run order, adjudicated finding, reconstruction prerequisite or INCONCLUSIVE rule changes the content-addressed experiment identity or fails validation; duplicate/unknown samples, fewer than the pinned class/repetition floor, and result-dependent contract edits cannot be accepted under the original experiment ID.

items.userSees: 用户运行 selfcheck 时看到："Protocol: PASS experimentId=<digest> classes=3 samples=6 repeats>=3 adjudicatedFindings=<n>"。

verificationEvidence.note: Owner 47-check rerun pins 3 classes/6 samples/3 repeats, 4 seeded oracles and 2 signed historical findings; protocol now declares assembledPrompt unavailable unless exact prompt bytes are pinned.
Owner rerun rejects locally-recomputed assembledPrompt semantics without pinned bytes; unavailable prompt/provider/cache/finding output remains reason-coded and nonnumeric.
Owner rerun rejects protocol/corpus/finding/version/floor mutations; README precisely lists signatureVersion among v1 hash-bound fields.

items.title: Build a read-only historical-material replay harness
items.context: Load immutable historical material without changing current Story state; replay both arms from the same pinned input and deterministically recompute prompt bytes, estimated tokens, content digests and finding comparisons.

happy.desc: For every valid historical sample the harness reconstructs immutable material once, feeds byte-identical pinned task/material/tool/model inputs to both A and B arms except for the pre-registered prompt-contract difference, and deterministically recomputes canonical prompt bytes, estimated tokens, content digests and adjudicated finding comparisons without modifying the source material or current Story state.

edge.desc: Repeated execution, reversed pre-registered arm order, repository-relative POSIX path normalization and semantically equivalent object insertion order preserve per-cell input/prompt digests and computed measurements; meaningful byte, model, tool, contract or material changes produce different digests instead of colliding or being silently normalized.

adversarial.desc: The replay entrypoint rejects caller-supplied precomputed digests, finding outcomes, production evidence paths, mutable live-Story material, path traversal/symlink escape and mixed-arm inputs; filesystem snapshots and command probes prove the read-only harness cannot write review pass, finding, ReviewRun, verification, phase or lifecycle artifacts.

items.userSees: 用户运行 replay 时看到："Replay: PASS sameInput=true deterministic=true"，并看到每个 sample/arm 的 bytes、estimatedTokens、promptDigest 和 findingComparison。

verificationEvidence.note: Owner normal/reverse reruns share experimentId 330d7937e85ea9e2ac50cb9c2cabc4ff60239695fb28677075fe6755b35fe152 and canonical historical metrics stay fail-closed.
Owner 47-check rerun covers order/repeat/path/object invariance and meaningful digest divergence.
Owner rerun rejects caller substitutions and now requires exact unique A/B arms and outputs in the hermetic evaluator.

items.title: Record dispatch usage and finding measurements in an isolated experiment ledger
items.context: Capture assembled prompt, known dispatch input, provider-reported usage/cache availability, contract/model versions, attempts and experiment findings in append-only experiment artifacts that cannot satisfy review pass, finding, ReviewRun, verification or lifecycle gates.

happy.desc: Each experiment dispatch attempt writes an append-only, experiment-namespace record keyed by experiment/cell/ledgerCallId/attemptId and bound to exact assembled-prompt, known-dispatch, model/contract, input and finding-set digests; it records prompt bytes/estimated tokens, known dispatch counts when observable, provider-reported uncached/cache-read/cache-creation/output usage when reported, latency/attempt disposition and experiment findings without acquiring gate authority.

edge.desc: Missing provider usage or a provider-specific missing cache dimension remains explicitly unavailable/unknown with reason, never inferred as zero; provider-reported zero is accepted only when actually reported, retries keep distinct attempt IDs, terminal summaries reconcile exactly one final disposition per attempt, and estimates are not double-counted after reported usage supersedes them.

adversarial.desc: Forged authority flags, production Story/review references, duplicate or out-of-order attempts, raw prompt/completion/transcript/tool arguments, credentials, malformed counts and digest substitution are rejected; registry/gate probes prove even a perfectly shaped experiment record cannot satisfy review pass, finding, ReviewRun, verificationEvidence, validation, TEST or DONE consumers.

items.userSees: 用户查看分析时看到："Experiment ledger: PASS gateEvidence=false attempts=<n>"；缺失 provider/cache 字段显示 "unavailable(<reason>)"，不会显示为 0。

verificationEvidence.note: Owner rerun verifies experiment-only chained records, exact identity binding, runtime confinement and gateEvidence=false; fd-backed serialized append prevents concurrent chain corruption.

Owner rerun covers unavailable-not-zero, distinct crash/retry attempts, terminal supersession, one terminal disposition per attempt, no estimate double counting, concurrent serialization and chain tamper rejection.

Owner rerun rejects forged authority/Story/review refs, raw prompt/transcript/tool args/credentials, malformed stored rows and rehashed privacy injection; normal usage-ledger and process-fact consumers reject experiment rows.

items.title: Fail closed on unreconstructable material and prove production evidence remains unchanged
items.context: Adversarial tests must cover missing/tampered/version-skewed historical inputs, partial provider usage and retry cases; return explicit INCONCLUSIVE when reconstruction or recall comparison is not valid, and prove no production pass/finding/run/lifecycle files or gate facts are written.

happy.desc: A fully reconstructable pinned sample produces an evaluable A/B result with explicit finding-recall and usage dimensions, while before/after canonical snapshots of production pass, finding, ReviewRun, verification, validation and lifecycle evidence are byte-identical and no production process-fact event is appended.

edge.desc: Valid prompt reconstruction with unavailable provider usage can still report assembled-prompt metrics while provider and cache conclusions remain unavailable; partial retry usage is attributed only to its attempt, and missing adjudication evidence, absent provider seed support, or insufficient repetitions constrains only the affected conclusion instead of becoming zero, pass, or a global success claim.

adversarial.desc: Missing/tampered/version-skewed historical inputs, mismatched material or finding digests, cross-arm input drift, incomplete sample floors and invalid recall denominators return explicit INCONCLUSIVE with stable reason codes and no savings/recall claim; injected experiment artifacts and crashes/restarts cannot mutate or be consumed as production pass, finding, ReviewRun, verification, validation, phase-transition or DONE evidence.

items.userSees: 有效样本显示 "Recall: EVALUABLE"；缺失或篡改样本显示 "Recall: INCONCLUSIVE reason=<stable-code>"；最后显示 "Production evidence drift: NONE"。

verificationEvidence.note: Owner rerun: the content-addressed hermetic valid reconstruction is EVALUABLE for exact prompt and semantic finding comparison only with scope=hermetic-selfcheck-only and historicalEvidence=false; canonical historical rows remain INCONCLUSIVE. Production evidence drift is NONE.

Owner replay reports prompt cost INCONCLUSIVE/PROMPT_SNAPSHOT_UNAVAILABLE and recall INCONCLUSIVE/ADJUDICATION_EVIDENCE_UNVERIFIED; signed historical finding identities do not fabricate replay outputs, provider or cache claims.

Owner rerun rejects missing/tampered/version-skewed inputs, forged finding signature, cross-Story reference, material/finding digest mismatch, invalid floors and denominators without savings/recall claims or production evidence writes.
